svg.title: Telemetry Lakehouse demo
svg.desc: Animated terminal recording of a real run: a valid stream is ingested and committed, DuckDB verifies it (18 SQL assertions), a corrupted batch is rejected, and DuckDB verifies the data is unchanged. Playback 70s; the commands really took 4.0s in total.

g.text: # 1. A valid stream: 20,000 events from 1,000 devices -> committed batches

text.tspan: source sim-seed42: read 20,000 records in 4 batches -> 20,000 rows committed in 4 files (0 batches already
accounting: consumed=20,000 accepted=20,000 duplicates=0 rejected=0 unresolved=0 committed=20,000
sequences: 0 gaps proven (0 events missing, basis: end_of_stream)

g.text: # DuckDB re-verifies the published Parquet with 18 independent SQL assertions

text.tspan: dataset : 20,000 events | 1,000 devices | 4 files | 4 committed batches | dates 2026-01-01 .. 2026-01-01

g.text: # 2. A second source with corrupted measurements injected

text.tspan: uv run telemetry simulate --events 20000 --seed 43 --device-prefix edge --out b.json
uv run telemetry simulate --events 20000 --seed 43 --device-prefix edge --out b.jsonl --fault in
uv run telemetry simulate --events 20000 --seed 43 --device-prefix edge --out b.jsonl --fault invalid_value=
uv run telemetry simulate --events 20000 --seed 43 --device-prefix edge --out b.jsonl --fault invalid_value=0.0002
uv run telemetry ingest --source b.jsonl --batch-size 5000 --format text
source sim-seed43: read 10,000 records in 2 batches -> 5,000 rows committed in 1 file (0 batches already
accounting: consumed=10,000 accepted=9,998 duplicates=0 rejected=2 unresolved=0 committed=5,000
(a blocked batch is classified but publishes nothing: committed counts only admitted batches)
run halted at the blocked batch: nothing after it was published

g.text: # 3. The rejected batch never reached the trusted data - DuckDB agrees

text.tspan: dataset : 25,000 events | 1,985 devices | 5 files | 5 committed batches | dates 2026-01-01 .. 2026-01-01
event_date events active_devices avg_temperature_c avg_battery_pct non_ok_pct
